concepts.def: A business that looks after money

A long loan to buy a house

walkthroughs.body_html:
Banks do four big things:

  • Hold your money safely.
  • Let you pay people.
  • Pay interest on savings.
  • Lend money — for a fee.

Put £100 in a savings account at 5% interest a year → after 1 year you have £105.

The £5 is your interest — your reward for waiting.

The longer you save, the more it grows. 📈

When the bank lends you money it charges interest.

Borrow £1,000 at 5% for a year → pay back £1,050.

A mortgage is a long loan to buy a house — sometimes lasting 25+ years. 🏠

mcqs.q: How does the sign of cross elasticity of demand (XED) reveal product relationships?
options: CPI measures consumer prices and RPI measures retail prices — that's the only difference.
The sign of XED doesn't matter — only the size does.
XED measures how often consumers cross-shop between stores.
Positive XED = substitutes (price of one rises, demand for the other rises); negative XED = complements (price of one rises, demand for the other falls); zero XED = unrelated goods.
XED measures how often consumers cross-shop between stores.
A negative externality is something bad that happens to a business.
A negative externality is a tax on a business.
A cost imposed on a third party not involved in the transaction — e.g. pollution from a factory affects neighbours who didn't choose to bear it.
